name: orch
description: Token-efficient agent orchestration (planner → worker → reviewer, bugfix, backend, parallel worktrees), guard against destructive commands, temp file cleanup, token & cost stats, Discord/WhatsApp notifications.

discord_webhook_url.title: Discord webhook URL
discord_webhook_url.description: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy URL. Empty = Discord off.

whatsapp_phone.title: WhatsApp phone number
whatsapp_phone.description: Your number in international format, e.g. +420123456789. Empty = WhatsApp off.

whatsapp_apikey.title: WhatsApp API key
whatsapp_apikey.description: CallMeBot apikey, or for Twilio ACCOUNT_SID:AUTH_TOKEN.

whatsapp_from.title: Twilio WhatsApp sender
whatsapp_from.description: Only for Twilio: sender number, e.g. +14155238886 (sandbox).

notify_min_seconds.title: Notify when a turn takes at least (s)
notify_min_seconds.description: A 'Claude finished' message is sent only for turns at least this long.
